project.name: Importer — HAR
project.description:
Turns a browser HAR capture into draft scenarios grouped into candidate journeys.
A HAR is the only source that records what a real user actually did, in what order and how often — which makes it the best starting point for a realistic traffic mix, and the most dangerous document this platform accepts.
It is a verbatim recording of a live session. Every cookie in it is a live cookie, every Authorization header a live token, and a sign-in request carries the password in plain text. It also records every static asset, every third-party beacon and every failed request the page made. So this importer removes far more than it keeps, and reports everything it removed: the value of a HAR is what a person does with it after reviewing it, and a draft that quietly smuggled a session into the platform would be worse than no draft.
Depends on platform-domain, plus Jackson for reading the capture — the same reasoning as importer-openapi. No Spring, persistence, engine or Kubernetes types; ModuleDependencyRulesTest enforces that.
